messages.subject: Dates in a certain range
parts:
Hi,

I have data points for two different date ranges, so my graph shows
points at the start and end, but no points in the centre (which is
correct). Is there any way of removing the centre of the graph, i.e.
only show points within certain date ranges depending on the data.

messages.author: a05c2790ee4a00bf
messages.subject: Re: Dates in a certain range
parts:
Hi, Sorry if I was unclearin my previous post, essentially, what I am
trying to do is:
scale_x_date(lim =2-12-2011:02-02-2012,02-04-2012:02-08-2012)
Is this possible with ggplot?
Thanks for your help

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Dates in a certain range
parts: I think what you're after is an axis break. I don't think this is possible, but you could fudge it a bit by splitting your data into two groups by the date ranges ("A" and "B") and then use faceting to put the two plots next to each other.
